items.q: What should you remember about **Execution > strategy**?
items.a: **index fund + don't** look beats clever tactics for most people.

items.q: What should you remember about **Earn first**?
items.a: **human capital and skill-market fit often dominate frugality.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Young save less?**?
items.a: **lifecycle research**: save more at higher income; pressure to save early can be suboptimal but risks bad habits.

items.q: What should you remember about **House ≠ investment**?
items.a: **consumption asset with unrecoverable** costs; 5% rule + PWL calculator.

items.q: What should you remember about **100% stocks debate**?
items.a: **academic challenge to bond** glide paths for long horizons.

items.q: What should you remember about **Cash under mattress**?
items.a: **3% inflation halves purchasing power in ~20 years.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Control the controllables**?
items.a: **plan, goals, allocation, emergency fund, tax** — not market timing.

items.q: What should you remember about **Advisor industry**?
items.a: **car-dealership sales culture; referral** doesn't guarantee quality (investment advisor incentive mismatch overlap).
